scope: Synthetic transport for diary/export helper paths only

results.case: Bootstrap does not invent a local date or mutate
A validated date is the entire day path, including a leap day
Calendar accepts exactly62 inclusive days and rejects longer/reversed/partial ranges before transport
PATCH preserves operation/version and source selections without adding a fresh intent
A stale personal revision cannot send a PATCH after explicit account replacement
Export adds a date cursor while preserving case in both existing UUID cursors
A diary UUID or invalid Gregorian date cannot be reused as after_diary
